note: Nov 27 2026, hand re-cut of the Nov 20 auto cut for Patrick's gate-1 review. Every boundary was placed from word timings and voice activity measured on the processed guest and Mira tracks (faster-whisper small.en, branch claude/project-thread-tia1bx, analysis/surendra/out/rev1); times are on the room clock. The auto cut had three faults: its cold open played 'I'm joining from McLean' (35.9-53.3) while its note claimed his thesis line; it read 'I start over' (describing other apps) as a restart request and dropped 929-991.8, 62 s of his answer on revenue optimisation, landing mid-sentence on 'again. So there's no loyalty' and removing the point the outro quotes; and it ended on the last eight seconds of his closing statement followed by 'Can you still hear me, Mira?'. Fixed here, plus Mira's timing faults: her cut-ins over him, garbled starts, a stray 'Ping.', a repeat-the-question loop, and the four-minute breakup after her closing question. No question was passed on or declined.

cuts.text: So the travel is not an event or it's not a transaction. It's an experience. It's a journey.
cuts.note: Cold open: his thesis in his own voice (the auto cut played the McLean line).
Mira's hello through 'McLean.' Out after it (47.1-49.0): her garbled 'Just out, McLean works.'

'I'm Mira...' through his '...everything should be working for you.' Out after it (148.4-158.0): 'And when I say you, it's a' cut off by Mira's garbled 'Travel as a continuous exp-, that shift from a one-time purchase? Right, the traveler.'
'What does that look like the first time someone uses ZenVoya' through 'That's what we do.' Mira's false start 'A human-' over his last words is muted; out after it (392.6-396.2) the rest of it.

'Same read, but scaled to every traveler at once' through 'Going deeper than surface taste,' - including his full revenue answer (929-991.8) the auto cut dropped. Out after it (1164.95-1178.3): her first wording of the why/what question, 'Can you repeat that please?' and 'Sure,'.
Her plainer wording of the question through 'An executable plan, not just a ping.' Out after it: a stray second 'Ping.' (1679.92-1680.62).

'You said messaging too...' through '...or it's not that urgent.' Mira's 'Sounds like' over his answer (1753.7) is muted. Out after it (1859.4-1869.0): his trailing 'In some indication of the' cut off by her 'Acknowledgement... the system.'

'Is that read coming from the traveler tapping something' through '...or anything else.' Mira's 'Jensen' over his answer (1973.2) is muted. Out after it (2162.3-2169.2): his 'Now you make a final' with her 'That final one,' on top of it.
Out before it (2170.4-2178.9): 'Yes.' and her stray 'Quiet.' In from 'Your first search patterns...' through '...to earn the customer trust.' Her 'Same root.' over him (2351.6) is muted.
Out before it (2362.5-2365.9): 'True across both', the second half of the muted line. In: 'What would you want a listener to sit with after this hour?'

Out before it (2368.9-2608.7): four minutes of breakup, 'can you repeat', 'can you hear me' and his 'Sorry, Mira, I can't hear you, but I think just to leave something at the end.' In: his answer to her closing question, whole, from 'So the travel industry does not need another better search' through '...that's what ZenVoya is building.' Out after it: 'Can you still hear me, Mira?'
